mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at 0.08% is historically low, and historical data shows that such levels consistently precede positive 20-day S&P 500 returns. This signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% is negative, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL rise above 280 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers equity valuation contractions and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns. This signal activates when CPIAUCSL exceeds 280.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when CPIAUCSL > 280 is positive, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of CPIAUCSL with 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS < 148000 (thousands) indicate labor market deterioration, which consistently predicts negative 5-day S&P 500 returns. The signal activates only when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where UNRATE>4.5 and PAYEMS<148000, 5-day returns are positive, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 > 19500 billion 2017 dollars indicates strong GDP growth, which typically produces positive 60-day S&P 500 returns. This signal is active only in strong GDP growth regimes.
failure_condition: The average 60-day return when GDPC1 > 19500 is negative, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of GDPC1 with 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE > 4.5% indicates labor market weakness, which consistently predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns. This signal activates when unemployment exceeds 4.5%.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return when UNRATE > 4.5 is positive, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of UNRATE with 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and INDPRO < 101.5 indicate monetary easing with economic weakness, which consistently predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 returns. The signal activates only when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS<0.1 and INDPRO<101.5, 20-day returns are positive, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST < 1500 thousand units indicates housing market weakness, which consistently predicts negative 5-day S&P 500 returns. This signal activates when housing starts fall below 1500.
failure_condition: The average 5-day return when HOUST < 1500 is positive, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of HOUST with 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 630000 million dollars indicate weak consumer demand, which consistently predicts negative 60-day S&P 500 returns. The signal activates only when both conditions are met.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where HOUST<1500 and RSAFS<630000, 60-day returns are positive, or the Walk-forward Rank IC of the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
